openapi: 3.1.0
info:
    title: Bookshop
    version: 1.0.0
    description: Catalogue and orders of an online bookshop.
    contact:
        email: books-api@example.com
servers:
-   url: https://api.bookshop.example.com
security:
-   bearerAuth: []
tags:
-   name: books
-   name: orders
paths:
    /books:
        get:
            tags: [books]
            summary: Search books
            description: Full-text search over titles and authors.
            operationId: searchBooks
            parameters:
            -   name: query
                in: query
                schema:
                    type: string
            responses:
                '200':
                    description: Matching books.
                    content:
                        application/json:
                            schema:
                                type: array
                                items:
                                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Book'
                '400':
                    description: Invalid search query.
                    content:
                        application/problem+json:
                            schema:
                                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    /Books/{isbn}:
        get:
            tags: [books]
            summary: Get a book
            description: Returns a book by ISBN.
            operationId: getBook
            parameters:
            -   name: isbn
                in: path
                required: true
                schema:
                    type: string
            responses:
                '200':
                    description: The book.
                    content:
                        application/json:
                            schema:
                                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Book'
                '404':
                    description: Unknown ISBN.
                    content:
                        application/problem+json:
                            schema:
                                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    /shopping-carts/{cartId}/checkout:
        post:
            tags: [orders]
            summary: Check out a cart
            description: Turns a shopping cart into an order and charges the customer.
            operationId: checkoutCart
            parameters:
            -   name: cartId
                in: path
                required: true
                schema:
                    type: string
            responses:
                '201':
                    description: The created order.
                    content:
                        application/json:
                            schema:
                                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'
                '409':
                    description: The cart is empty or already checked out.
                    content:
                        application/problem+json:
                            schema:
                                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
                '503':
                    description: The payment provider is unavailable.
                    content:
                        application/problem+json:
                            schema:
                                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
components:
    securitySchemes:
        bearerAuth:
            type: http
            scheme: bearer
    schemas:
        Book:
            type: object
            required: [isbn, title]
            properties:
                isbn:
                    type: string
                title:
                    type: string
                authorNames:
                    type: array
                    items:
                        type: string
                publishedYear:
                    type: integer
        Order:
            type: object
            required: [orderId, totalAmount]
            properties:
                orderId:
                    type: string
                totalAmount:
                    type: number
                currencyCode:
                    type: string
        Problem:
            type: object
            properties:
                type:
                    type: string
                title:
                    type: string
                status:
                    type: integer
